doc: queryRecords: search, then filter, then sort, over the task fixture; deleted records never show (08 is deleted). The filter and the sorts are prepared first, so a half-edited view still shows something. Search covers every field except a secret one (notes).

cases.name: no search, filter or sort: the live records in id order
a search looks in the title, the labels of linked records and people
a search ignores case and accents both ways
a search with an accent finds the plain letters
a secret field is never searched
a field that is only personal is searched
a search reads a person's name
a search reads an option's label
a search reads an attachment's name
a search of spaces searches nothing
a search, a filter and a sort together
an unfinished filter and an unknown sort are ignored
